sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module introduces students to the basic principles of structural design and construction materials and methodologies. It aims to provide core knowledge, critical understanding and applied experience by focusing on the integration of the technical requirements with the architectural form and the relevant sustainability criteria.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Explain the fundamental principles of structural behaviour and construction techniques, including how forces, loads, and assembly methods influence architectural design. B. Recognise the main structural systems and construction materials, their applications, key properties and performance indicators C. Apply and interpret simple digital design software and AI optimization tools, to simulate the relationship between structural form and material efficiancy and sustainability. D. Communicate structural and material concepts effectively through technical drawings, diagrams, and verbal explanations in a design context.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Subject material will be delivered by formal lectures supported by speculative structural experiments and small exercises. Students are encouraged to learn through the use of models, drawings and materials research.
